column10: {"zh":"本发明公开了一种纸手帕折叠加工设备，包括设置在机台上依次衔接的纵向折叠机组、横向折叠机组和百花盘机组，纸幅依次张紧穿设在纵向折叠机组和横向折叠机组上。纸手帕通过所述纵向折叠机沿宽度方向以“Z”字形折叠成三个折叠面，然后通过所述横向折叠机沿长度方向再对折两次，折叠成四个折叠面。本本发明不仅生产效率高，速度快，降低了生产成本，而且生产的纸张规格可调，产品携带方便，更加精美。"}

column10: {"en":"The invention discloses a paper handkerchief folding machining device. The paper handkerchief folding machining device comprises a longitudinal folding machine set, a transverse folding machine set and a flower plate machine set, wherein the longitudinal folding machine set, the transverse folding machine set and the flower plate machine set are sequentially jointed on a machine platform. Paper webs are sequentially arranged on the longitudinal folding machine set and the transverse folding machine set in a tensioning and penetrating mode. A paper handkerchief is folded into three folding surfaces in a Z-shaped mode in the width direction through a longitudinal folding machine, and refolded twice in the length direction to form four folding surfaces through a transverse folding machine. The paper handkerchief folding machining device is high in production efficiency and in speed and capable of reducing production cost. The size of produced paper can be adjusted, and products are convenient to carry and attractive."}

column10: 本发明公开了一种纸巾折叠加工装置。该纸巾折叠加工装置包括纵向折叠机组、横向折叠机组及花板机组，所述纵向折叠机组、横向折叠机组与花板机组依次衔接安装在机台上。纸幅以张紧穿设的方式依次布置于纵向折叠机组与横向折叠机组上。纸巾经纵向折叠机沿宽度方向 Z 形折叠形成三个折面，并通过横向折叠机沿长度方向二次折叠形成四个折面。本纸巾折面 **。本纸巾折叠加工装置生产效率高、速度快，可降低生产成本；所生产纸巾尺寸可调，产品便于携带且外形美观。
